title: Interim Accounts Assistant Creative Agency London (On-site)
description:
Interim Accounts Assistant Creative Production & Events Business London (On-site)

The Client

Harmonic is delighted to be partnering with a well-established creative business that delivers high-quality projects and live brand experiences for a portfolio of well-known consumer brands. They operate at the premium end of their market, where craft and quality matter, and take pride in bespoke, made-to-order work. With the finance team evolving, they are looking for a reliable Accounts Assistant to come in and keep things running smoothly through a busy period.

The Role

Reporting to and working alongside the Management Accountant, this is a hands-on, transactional finance role supporting a small, close-knit team based on-site in South West London. You will take ownership of the day-to-day accounts payable and input work: posting purchase invoices, processing timesheets, and handling company credit card and expense reconciliations, keeping the finance function moving while the team finalises its longer-term structure. It is an immediate-start temporary contract with genuine potential to extend, or to convert to a permanent role, for someone who does a great job. The business runs on Xero.

Key Responsibilities
- Post and process purchase invoices accurately and to deadline.
- Process weekly timesheets and reconcile against records.
- Manage company credit card and staff expense reconciliations.
- Support the wider accounts payable cycle, including payment runs and supplier queries.
- Keep the finance inbox and records tidy and up to date.
- Provide day-to-day support to the Management Accountant and wider finance team.
- Help keep things on track through month-end and busier periods.

Essential Experience
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Accounts Payable, or transactional finance role.
- Confident posting and processing invoices, and comfortable with the core AP cycle.
- Reliable and able to hit the ground running with minimal training.
- Strong attention to detail and clear communication.
- Available to start at short notice and to be on-site in South West London 5 days per week.

Desirable Experience
- Experience using Xero (or a similar accounting package; the core skills transfer).
- Exposure to timesheet processing, or to a project-based or creative business.

Day Rate: £150-£175 per day, dependent on experience

Contract: 3-month temporary contract, with genuine potential to extend or go permanent

Location: On-site in Wimbledon, London, 5 days per week. Well served by the District line and Overground.

Start Date: ASAP, ideally week commencing 22 September

Please feel free to get in touch with Ewan Fenley for more information.

Please feel free to share this with any friends or colleagues that may be interested.

title: Assistant Management Accountant
description:
Assistant Management Accountant

Hybrid Working Study Support Excellent Benefits Career Development

Are you an ambitious Assistant Management Accountant looking for a role where you can take ownership, broaden your experience and play a genuine part in a growing business?

Our client is a dynamic, PE-backed technology business with ambitious growth plans and an exciting future ahead. As the company continues to expand, they are strengthening their finance function and are looking for a talented Assistant Management Accountant to join their fast-paced, collaborative team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a part-qualified accountant or someone actively studying towards ACCA or CIMA who wants more than just a processing role. You'll gain broad exposure across management accounts, month-end, balance sheet control, reconciliations, reporting and wider finance projects, while working closely with senior finance colleagues and stakeholders across the business.

The Role

Reporting into the Finance Manager, you'll take ownership of a broad range of accounting responsibilities and become an important member of the finance team. Your responsibilities will include:
- Assisting with the preparation of monthly management accounts, including P&L and balance sheet reporting.
- Taking ownership of weekly bank reconciliations and investigating any discrepancies.
- Managing balance sheet accounts and performing key system control reconciliations.
- Preparing and processing payments through the banking platform and allocating transactions within NetSuite.
- Completing credit card and travel expense reconciliations.
- Supporting the full month-end close process, including fixed assets, prepayments and other accounting adjustments.
- Working closely with the Accounts Payable team and acting as a key point of contact between AP and other areas of Finance.
- Completing payroll and employee benefit reconciliations.
- Supporting the Finance Manager with reporting, tax filings and other statutory requirements.
- Assisting with year-end and audit activities throughout the year.
- Identifying discrepancies, investigating issues and helping to improve finance processes and controls.
- Working with colleagues across the wider business to ensure accurate and timely financial information.
- Taking ownership of your responsibilities while contributing to wider finance projects as the business continues to grow.

What They Are Looking For:

They are looking for someone who is commercially minded, inquisitive and keen to develop. You should enjoy getting into the details but also want to understand the bigger picture and how finance supports the wider business. Ideally, you will have:
- At least one year's experience in a similar Assistant Management Accountant or management accounting role.
- Experience of working with multi-currency and/or multi-company accounts, ideally within a fast-paced corporate environment.
- Experience within the technology sector would be advantageous.
- A graduate background and be part-qualified or actively studying towards ACCA or CIMA.
- Good knowledge of month-end reporting, with a strong understanding of P&L and balance sheet accounting.
- Excellent Excel skills and strong analytical and numerical ability.
- Experience of working with an ERP system; NetSuite experience would be advantageous, although other major ERP systems will be considered.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong organisation skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- The confidence to communicate effectively with colleagues at all levels, including non-finance stakeholders.
- A proactive, hands-on approach with the initiative to identify problems and suggest improvements.
- The ability to work independently and take ownership, while also enjoying being part of a friendly and collaborative finance team.

Why Join?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a high-growth, PE-backed technology business at an exciting stage of its journey.

You'll have the opportunity to develop your technical accounting skills, gain wider commercial exposure and work closely with experienced finance professionals. With study support, hybrid working and a strong benefits package, this is a role designed for someone who wants to build their career rather than simply move into another job.

If you're ambitious, commercially curious and ready to take the next step in your accounting career, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for.

After a qualifying period, the company will offer a comprehensive study support package, outstanding benefits and an excellent career development opportunity.

Apply Now

As Credit Controller, you'll be responsible for keeping customer accounts up to date and ensuring outstanding invoices are followed up effectively.

You'll take a structured approach to your ledger, identifying overdue accounts, investigating issues and agreeing payment solutions with customers. You'll also work closely with internal departments where billing, contractual or account queries are preventing payment.

Experience dealing with complicated invoices, underpayments and legacy payments will be very beneficial. Further experience conducting investigations into aged debt and outstanding invoices will be very a great asset for this credit control role.

There may also be opportunities to support finance and operational teams during major events, giving the role a broader commercial dimension than a traditional credit control position.

Key Duties:
- Take day-to-day responsibility for an allocated customer ledger.
- Monitor outstanding invoices and carry out regular collection activity.
- Contact customers by telephone and email to agree payment dates and resolve overdue balances.
- Review aged debt and determine appropriate follow-up actions.
- Maintain accurate notes and records of collection activity.
- Investigate account discrepancies, invoice queries and disputed balances.
- Produce customer statements and respond to account-related enquiries.
- Work with Sales and other departments to resolve issues affecting payment.
- Reconcile customer and sales information between internal systems and NetSuite.
- Help minimise aged debt, credit notes and unallocated cash.
- Ensure payments are chased ahead of key event and operational deadlines.
- Maintain accurate customer account information.
- Deal confidently with customers across different markets and currencies.
- Provide assistance to on-site teams with customer payments when required.

We're particularly interested in candidates who have:
- Solid Credit Control or Accounts Receivable experience.
- Previous experience using NetSuite.
- Good Excel skills.
- Experience dealing with multi-currency accounts and international customers.
- A good understanding of VAT and financial processes.
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
- The confidence to deal with customers regarding overdue payments.
- Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
- Good organisation and the ability to prioritise a busy workload.
- A proactive approach to resolving problems rather than simply reporting them.
- Experience within events, exhibitions, media or another fast-moving commercial environment would be advantageous.

The Working Environment

The company has an informal and sociable culture, offering a refreshing alternative to a traditional corporate finance environment.

You'll be working in a relaxed office with a casual dress code, alongside a team that regularly gets together for social events, celebrations and nights out.

The business is continuing to grow internationally, so this is an opportunity to join a finance function where there is plenty of activity and exposure to different areas of the organisation.

Package:
- Salary: £34,000 - £36,000
- Location: Central London
- Hybrid: 3 days in the office / 2 days from home
- Start: Immediate
- Holiday: 25 days + 8 bank holidays
- Pension: Company pension scheme
- Additional benefits: Cycle to Work scheme and Season Ticket Loan

You will play a pivotal role in delivering high-quality Right to Manage (RTM) services to leaseholder clients, using a meticulous approach to detail and a calm, organised style to run your own caseload end-to-end. From early-stage eligibility checks to acquisition, you will keep every matter moving, anticipating risks, meeting deadlines, and communicating clearly with all parties.

You will also be part of Odevo's technology-enabled legal services journey. You will embrace digital tools, contribute ideas to improve workflows, and use data and automation to drive consistency, speed, and a better experience for residents, landlords, and internal teams.

ROLE EXPECTATIONS

Most days, you will progress a portfolio of RTM matters, preparing and serving notices, drafting documents, managing timelines, and liaising with clients, freeholders, and agents. You will keep immaculate records in our case management system, provide timely updates, and collaborate with colleagues in property management and tech to refine processes and solve problems.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
- You move RTM cases from instruction to acquisition smoothly, on time, and with minimal escalations.
- Your files are accurate, audit-ready, and demonstrate consistent application of RTM procedures and statutory timelines.
- Clients feel informed and supported, with proactive updates and clear, jargon-free advice.
- You spot risks early, propose practical solutions, and escalate only when needed.
- You use technology to increase speed and quality, contributing ideas that improve templates and workflows.
- You build trusted relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders, helping resolve issues collaboratively.

HOW YOU'LL SPEND MOST OF YOUR TIME
- Conducting RTM eligibility checks, title reviews, and due diligence on buildings, leases, and tenant participation.
- Preparing, serving, and tracking statutory notices, including Notices of Invitation to Participate and Notices of Claim.
- Managing critical dates, responses, and counter-notices, and coordinating the acquisition process.
- Drafting correspondence and standard documents, and maintaining accurate file notes and document bundles.
- Liaising with leaseholders, RTM company directors, landlords, managing agents, and external advisors.
- Updating the case management system, generating reports, and refining templates and processes with our tech tools.

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR
- You are detail-obsessed, organised, and comfortable running your own caseload with appropriate oversight.
- You communicate clearly and empathetically, tailoring explanations to non-legal audiences.
- You stay calm under pressure, prioritise effectively, and keep multiple matters moving at pace.
- You are tech-curious, keen to use and improve digital tools that enhance quality and efficiency.
- You take ownership, seek feedback, and enjoy working collaboratively to deliver great outcomes.

EXPERIENCE THAT HELPS
- Exposure to leasehold law, RTM processes, or property litigation in a law firm, in-house team, or specialist service provider.
- Hands-on experience with case management systems, document automation, or data-driven dashboards.
- Drafting and serving statutory notices, and managing matter timelines and critical dates.
- Client-facing experience, balancing empathy with commercial pragmatism in written and verbal communications.
- Coordinating multi-stakeholder matters and preparing orderly, audit-ready legal files.

WHAT WE OFFER
- Competitive salary
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Salary sacrifice scheme and the option to buy annual leave
- Spectrum Life wellbeing platform
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Fully funded training and professional development
- Employee referral scheme, up to £1,500

ABOUT ODEVO UK

We are on a mission to become the leading international force in residential property management. What we do matters to billions of people in their everyday lives.

Residential real estate is the world's largest asset class, and for most families, buying a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long, residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents' expectations, and the industry is ready for change. Odevo was formed to make that change happen.

In just six years, Odevo has grown more than 70-fold, establishing us as the leading international player. We are more than 12,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, and Italy building Odevo. Together, we aspire to break new ground through innovation and cultivate a workplace where we help each other succeed, where ideas matter more than titles, and where kindness is a strength.

By combining the power of people and technology, we set a new standard for how homes are managed. Our technology-enabled services simplify living for residents and create a better experience for property owners and boards.

Our ambition is to continue our fast-growing journey through new customers, service expansion, and by partnering with great companies that share our mindset and ambition, both in existing and new markets.

As we continue to grow, we stay true to who we are, challenge unnecessary bureaucracy, and keep decision-making close to our customers.

If you share our mindset and ambition, we'd love you to join us and help accelerate our mission together.

HOW WE HIRE

We aim to complete the process within two to three weeks and communicate clearly throughout.

INTERESTED?

Apply with your CV.

title: Accounts Assistant

company: The Law Support Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
About the role

We are recruiting on behalf of a specialist City law firm with an active contentious practice. They need an experienced litigation paralegal to work alongside their disputes lawyers on cases covering the full IP spectrum: patents, trade marks, copyright, designs (registered and unregistered), passing off, confidential information and trade secrets, as well as technology-led commercial claims.

It's a hands-on position with real responsibility from day one. You'll be involved at every stage of a case, from pre-action through to trial, and will deal directly with clients, counsel and the court. Well suited to a paralegal who sees their future in contentious IP.

Day to day

Casework and drafting
- Helping the team run live disputes, working with fee-earners at all levels.
- Producing first drafts of applications, witness statements, letters, consent orders and general procedural paperwork, ready for a lawyer to approve.
- Preparing chronologies, summaries of key documents, case management reports, costs budgets and statements of costs.
- Carrying out legal and factual research, and helping gather evidence and take witness accounts.

Court and counsel
- Issuing and lodging documents electronically (CE-File and similar) and keeping on top of correspondence from the court.
- Acting as the day-to-day contact for court staff, judges' clerks, tribunals and outside service providers.
- Working with chambers to fix hearings, conferences and mediations, and drafting instructions to counsel.
- Getting cases trial-ready, going to court with the team where needed and drafting orders afterwards.

Disclosure, bundles and case management
- Running disclosure and e-disclosure, from document review through to production.
- Assembling hearing, trial and authorities bundles in hard copy and electronic form.
- Tracking procedural deadlines and directions, and keeping case trackers, disclosure logs and hearing diaries up to date.
- Keeping matter records accurate and in line with internal procedures.

Clients and the wider team
- Liaising with clients, expert witnesses, patent and trade mark attorneys, and third parties.
- Contributing to business development activity.

What you'll need
- Two to three years in a contentious IP paralegal role, with cases you have followed through to trial.
- Solid grounding in CPR procedure, plus hands-on experience drafting, issuing and filing court documents.
- Confidence dealing with the court, barristers' clerks and external counsel.
- Strong Excel skills: building and maintaining trackers, handling large volumes of review data, preparing costs schedules and producing reports. Fluent across the rest of the Microsoft Office suite.
- Comfortable using DMS and e-disclosure platforms.
- Precise, highly organised and able to manage competing deadlines without losing accuracy.
- Clear, professional communication in writing and in person.
- Discretion with confidential and sensitive material.

Nice to have
- A law degree, GDL, LPC, or SQE study underway or completed.
- Exposure to expert evidence or technically complex cases.

The person

You are proactive, solution-focused and comfortable taking ownership of your own work, but equally at home as part of a close team. You have commercial awareness, a genuine interest in IP and ambitions to keep progressing in disputes work.

description:
Payroll Assistant - Education, Tutoring & Social Work

Location: Loughton
Salary: £18 PH
Hours: 37.5 HRS Per Week ( 5 Days ) 6 Month Contract Only
Reports to: Payroll Manager / Finance Manager

About the Role

We are a fast-paced recruitment company specialising in the education, tutoring and social work sectors. Due to the high volume of workers we support, we are looking for an organised, accurate and proactive Payroll Assistant to join our busy payroll team.

This is a hands-on role supporting the processing of payroll for many temporary and contract workers. You will work closely with our recruitment and operations teams, managed service vendors and local authorities to ensure hours are received, checked and processed accurately and on time.

The successful candidate will ideally have previous payroll or payroll administration experience and be confident working with large volumes of data. Experience using Merit Payroll Software and/or managed vendor systems for submitting hours to local authorities would be highly advantageous.

This is also a great opportunity for someone who wants to develop their payroll knowledge and, over time, become confident in independently running payroll from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist with the weekly/monthly processing of payroll for a high volume of education, tutoring and social work workers.
- Accurately input and maintain worker payroll information and booking details.
- Check and process timesheets and hours worked, ensuring information is complete and accurate.
- Work with managed service vendors and local authorities to ensure hours are submitted correctly and within deadlines.
- Assist with setting up new worker bookings and ensuring all relevant payroll information is recorded correctly.
- Process leavers/finishers accurately and ensure all necessary records are updated.
- Respond promptly to payroll queries from workers, consultants, clients and internal teams.
- Investigate discrepancies and resolve payroll issues quickly and professionally.
- Assist with payroll checks and reconciliations before payroll is finalised.
- Ensure all required payroll reports are produced and checked.
- Maintain accurate records and ensure payroll information is kept up to date.
- Work closely with recruitment and operations teams to resolve missing information or discrepancies.
- Assist with ensuring compliance with relevant payroll legislation and processes.
- Support the payroll team with general administration and other payroll-related tasks as required.

Payroll Knowledge

The ideal candidate will have a good working knowledge of, or be keen to develop their understanding of:
- PAYE and income tax
- National Insurance (NI)
- Statutory Sick Pay (SSP)
- Statutory Maternity Pay (SMP)
- Holiday pay
- Starters and leavers
- Payroll deductions
- Timesheet and payroll processes

You don't need to be an expert in every area from day one, but you should have a good understanding of payroll principles and be keen to build your knowledge.

Systems & Skills

Ideally, you will have:
- Experience using Merit Payroll Software or a similar payroll system.
- Experience working with managed service providers/vendors and submitting hours to local authorities.
- Strong Excel and data-entry skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- The ability to work confidently with large volumes of data.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage deadlines.
- The ability to prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to resolving queries.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is accurate, reliable, organised and quick to respond.

Our payroll environment is busy and high-volume, so you will need to be comfortable working to tight deadlines and dealing with a variety of queries throughout the day. Attention to detail is particularly important, as even small errors can have a significant impact on workers' pay.

The right person will also be someone who wants to learn and progress. Initially, you will support the payroll function, but as your knowledge and confidence develop, you will be expected to take increasing responsibility for the payroll process.

Development of the Role

The long-term aim is for the successful candidate to become confident in running payroll independently, including:
- Setting up new bookings and workers correctly.
- Checking and processing hours.
- Ensuring starters and finishers are recorded correctly.
- Carrying out payroll checks and reconciliations.
- Running and reviewing all required payroll reports.
- Dealing with payroll queries and resolving discrepancies.
- Ensuring payroll is processed accurately and on time.
- Taking ownership of the payroll process from start to finish.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong payroll administration background who wants to develop their skills and take the next step towards becoming a fully independent payroll professional.

description:

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking for a part time receptionist (18 hrs per week) to join our friendly team. The role of a GP receptionist is an important part of the practice. Reception is often the first point of contact for patients, whether this is face-to-face, over the telephone, or through online services. As a receptionist, your role is not simply about answering the phone or booking appointments. You are part of the wider practice team and play an important role in helping patients access the right service and ensuring the practice runs smoothly. Welcoming patients and providing a friendly and professional first point of contact. Answering telephone calls and dealing with patient queries. Booking, cancelling and changing appointments appropriately. Helping patients understand how they can access the different services available. Signposting patients to the most appropriate healthcare professional or service. Processing administrative requests and updating patient information. Handling confidential and sensitive information appropriately. Supporting GPs, nurses, care coordinators and the wider practice team. Managing patient requests through systems such as the NHS App and online consultation services. Ensuring messages and requests are passed to the appropriate team member. Following practice policies, procedures and confidentiality requirements. As a GP Receptionist, you will be the first point of contact for patients, providing a friendly, professional and welcoming service. You will handle patient enquiries, book and manage appointments, answer telephone calls, process administrative tasks and signpost patients to the appropriate service. The role requires excellent communication and organisational skills, a calm and professional manner, and the ability to work effectively as part of a busy practice team. Confidentiality, accuracy and a patient-centred approach are essential.

description: Golborne Canalside Health Centre is a small and friendly community-minded GP practice operating in an area of high health inequality. We work together to provide excellent NHS primary care services and to support our patient population through partnerships with community organisations, technological innovation, and training the next generation of GPs. Golborne Canalside Health Centre is seeking a friendly, organised and motivated Part-Time Receptionist / Administrator to join our supportive GP practice team as we move into our bespoke new premises, from which we will run both NHS services and innovative, community -based projects. As an integral part of our patient-focused environment, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring seamless operations and exceptional care delivery. Your primary responsibility will be to provide efficient administrative support and excellent customer service to patients and healthcare professionals. This includes providing front desk duties and conducting administrative duties, such as email management, appointment booking and making hospital referrals. Utilize electronic scheduling systems to manage appointments and maintain an organized schedule. 3. Communication and Information Management: a. Answer phone calls, respond to inquiries, and provide information on clinic services and procedures. b. Liaise with healthcare professionals, hospitals, and external agencies to facilitate referrals and coordinate patient care. 4. Record Keeping and Data Entry: a. Maintain accurate electronic and paper-based patient records, ensuring compliance with data protection regulations. b. Provide general administrative support, including filing, photocopying, and managing correspondence. 6. Medical Supplies and Inventory Management: a. Follow NHS guidelines, policies, and procedures related to confidentiality, security, and healthcare compliance. Other related delegated duties considered appropriate to the post as directed. Recognise peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly. Ensure that no confidential communication takes place within hearing distance of patients. Demonstrate interpersonal skills when dealing with all levels of staff across the BGPA using persuasion, tact and reassurance where necessary. Manage all telephone calls related to the services, ensuring callers are communicated with in a sensitive and effective manner and problems are dealt with promptly and efficiently. The post holder is required to follow Bromley GP Alliance policies and procedures which are regularly updated including: Confidentiality / Data Protection / Freedom of Information Post holders must maintain the confidentiality of information about patients, staff and other health service business in accordance with the Data Protection Act of 1998. Post holders must not, without prior permission, disclose any information regarding patients or staff. If any member of staff has communicated any such information to an unauthorised person those staff will be liable to dismissal. Moreover, the Data Protection Act 1998 also renders an individual liable for prosecution in the event of unauthorised disclosure of information. Following the Freedom of Information Act (FOI) 2005, post holders must apply the Bromley GP Alliances FOI procedure if they receive a written request for information. Equal Opportunities Post holders must always fulfil their responsibilities regarding the Bromley GP Alliances Equal Opportunities Policy and equality laws. Health and Safety All post holders have a responsibility, under the Health and Safety at Work Act (1974) and subsequently published regulations, to ensure that the Trusts health and safety policies and procedures are complied with to maintain a safe working environment for patients, visitors and employees. Infection Control All post holders have a personal obligation to act to reduce healthcare-associated infections (HCAIs). They must complete mandatory training in Infection Control and be compliant with all measures required by the Trust to reduce HCAIs. All post holders must comply with the Bromley GP Alliance infection screening and immunisation policies as well as be familiar with the Trusts Infection Control Policies, including those that apply to their duties, such as Hand Decontamination Policy, Personal Protective Equipment Policy, safe procedures for using aseptic techniques and safe disposal of sharps. Risk Management All post holders have a responsibility to report risks such as clinical and non-clinical accidents or incidents promptly. They are expected to be familiar with the Trusts use of risk assessments to predict and control risk, as well as the incident reporting system for learning from mistakes and near misses to improve services. Post holders must also attend training identified by their manager or stated by the Trust to be mandatory. Safeguarding children and vulnerable adults Post holders have a general responsibility for safeguarding children and vulnerable adults in the course of their daily duties and for ensuring that they are aware of the specific duties relating to their role. Smoking Policy It is the Trusts policy to promote health. Smoking, therefore, is actively discouraged. It is illegal within Trust buildings and vehicles. Review of this Job Description This job description is intended as an outline of the general areas of activity and will be amended in the light of the changing needs of the organisation. To be reviewed in conjunction with the post holder.

description: We are looking to appoint a Receptionists/Administrator. You will have excellent communication skills, a compassionate and friendly nature who can operate in a busy environment with a range of people and professions, as you will be working in our clinical and administration teams. Your regular duties in this role will be dealing with telephone, face to face and electronic enquiries, booking and/or amending patient appointments and home visits, contacting patients to provide information from the clinical team and assisting patients to access our services and those available in the wider community. This role is ideal for someone who has previous experience in a GP surgery, is highly organised and an effective communicator who can provide a professional and warm welcome to our patients, ensuring every contact is of the highest quality. IT skills are essential, as you will be regularly creating searches, data input and monitoring our achievements and progress against national, local, and internal targets. You will also process prescription requests and provide a full administrative and secretarial service. All hours will be worked between 08:00 and 18:30, Monday to Friday. Job Responsibilities Reception & Patient Services Welcome and assist patients, liaising with the practice team and healthcare professionals. Manage appointments via EMIS, Accurx and telephone, including bookings, cancellations, recalls and consultations. Register new patients and temporary residents, ensuring accurate records. Handle enquiries, messages and requests, directing patients to appropriate services. Process home visit requests and arrange transport for housebound patients. Maintain telephone, answerphone and appointment systems. Administration Open/secure practice premises in line with procedures. Process incoming/outgoing mail, filing, scanning, photocopying and data entry. Maintain accurate records and process information in accordance with practice protocols. Keep reception, noticeboards and patient information areas tidy and presentable. Provide administrative support to the practice team and cover absences/overtime when required. Complete mandatory and statutory training and other reasonable duties. Medical Records & Prescriptions Prepare, retrieve, file and maintain accurate patient records and correspondence. Process repeat prescriptions in accordance with practice guidelines and issue completed prescriptions safely. Consulting Rooms Prepare, clean, check and restock consulting rooms before and after sessions, ensuring they are secure and ready for use. RECEPTIONIST / ADMINISTRATOR Job Title: Receptionist/Administrator Salary / Grade: £14 Hours per week: 37.5 hours Reports to: Deputy Practice Manager Job Summary: We are looking to appoint a Receptionists/Administrator to join our busy GP practice who will be the first point of contact for patients, contractors, and visitors as well as carrying out general office management tasks. You will be responsible for the general administrative and reception duties within the Practice and work with our established processes, policies and procedures to provide a comprehensive high quality service and deal efficiently and courteously with patient enquiries. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organised and an effective communicator who can provide a professional and warm welcome to our patients, ensuring every contact is of the highest quality. RECEPTION Receiving patients, consulting with members of practice team. Maintain and monitor the practice appointment system (EMIS) by processing personal and telephone requests for appointments ande-requests (Accurx), telephone consultations and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional. Register new patients, temporary residents and any requiring immediate and necessary treatment, carefully checking all details for accuracy and enter on computer registration link Taking messages and passing on information. Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team member and associated healthcare agencies and providers. Ensure that system is operational at the beginning of each day and switched over to night service and that the answer phone operational at the end of each day. Opening up/locking up of practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with practice protocols Processing and distributing incoming and outgoing mail. Filing and retrieving paperwork. Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with practice procedures. Providing clerical assistance to practice staff as required, including word/data processing, filing, photocopying, and scanning. Keeping the reception area, notice boards, leaflet etc. tidy and presentable. Cover sickness/annual leave and work reasonable overtime when required, including some weekends. Perform any other relevant and reasonable duties that may be requested by the Deputy Practice Manager, Practice Manager andPartners. Undertake statutory and mandatory training as required. APPOINTMENT SYSTEM MANAGEMENT Book/edit/cancel appointments and recalls ensuring sufficient information is recorded to retrieve medical record. Monitor effectiveness of the system and report any problems or variations required. Deal with home visit requests, carefully noting all details Arrange transport to hospital appointments for housebound patients. MEDICAL RECORDS MANAGEMENT Ensure that all records are accurately compiled in advance for each consulting session. Retrieve and refile records as required, ensuring that strict alphabetical order is adhered to. Ensure correspondence, reports, results, etc., are filed in correct record. Ensure records are kept neat and tidy and in good repair with all necessary information recorded correctly on the outer cover. Processing repeat prescriptions in accordance with practice guidelines. Handing completed repeat prescriptions to patient and checking names and address. CONSULTATION ROOM PREPARATIONS Clearing and re-stocking of consulting rooms as required. Consulting rooms prepared in readiness for each consulting session. Rooms are checked at the end of each consulting session and left tidy and secure. Other Job Responsibilities CONFIDENTIALITY Maintain confidentiality of information, acting within the terms of the Data Protection Act and Caldicott guidance on patient confidentiality at all times. Maintain an awareness of the Freedom of Information Act. Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the Practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data HEALTH & SAFETY The post-holder will manage their own and others health & safety and infection control as defined in the Practices Health & Safety Policy, the Practice Health & Safety Manual, and the Practices Infection Control Policy and published procedures. Comply with Practice health & safety policies by following agreed safe working procedures. Actively report health & safety hazards and infection hazards immediately Keeping work and general areas clean and tidy, and using appropriate infection control procedures to keep work areas hygienic and safe from contamination. Undertaking periodic infection control training (minimum annually) Awareness and compliance with national standards of infection control, hygiene, regulatory / contractual / professional requirements, and good practice guidelines. Correct personal use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and ensuring correct use of PPE by others, advising on appropriate circumstances for use by clinicians, staff and patients. Reporting incidents using the organisations Incident Reporting System Using personal security systems within the workplace according to Practice guidelines Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills EQUALITY AND DIVERSITY The post-holder will support, promote and maintain the Practices Equality & Diversity Policy. No person whether they are staff, patient or visitor should receive less favourable treatment because of their gender, ethnic origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion etc. The jobholder must comply with all policies and procedures designed to ensure equality of employment and that services are delivered in ways that meet the individual needs of patients and their families. title: Medical Receptionist
description: To act as the first point of contact for patients, visitors, and healthcare professionals contacting Albion Street Group Practice. The post holder will provide a professional, compassionate, and efficient reception and administrative support service, ensuring the smooth operational running of the practice and high standards of patient care. Welcome patients and visitors to the practice warmly, efficiently, and professionally. Answer incoming telephone calls, handling enquiries, scheduling appointments, and routing calls Manage patient requests for repeat prescriptions, test results, and general practice information in accordance with practice protocols. Utilise the practice clinical system EMIS Web to book, reschedule, and cancel appointments for GPs, nurses, and allied healthcare professionals. Manage signposting and care navigation to direct patients to the most suitable service or clinician (e.g., GP, practice nurse, pharmacist, or local community services). Monitor e-consultations and online booking requests, Process incoming and outgoing medical correspondence, scan clinical documents into patient records, and workflow tasks to appropriate team members. Process repeat prescription requests accurately and liaise with local pharmacies when necessary. Register new patients, update demographic details, and process temporary patient registrations. Support doctors and nursing staff with daily administrative tasks Ensure the reception area, waiting room, and desk environments remain tidy, safe, and stocked with relevant patient information leaflets. Assist with opening and securing the practice premises according to standard operating procedures. Participate in staff meetings, training sessions, and annual appraisals. Comply with CQC Policies KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Reception & Patient Navigation Welcome patients and visitors to the surgery in a warm, empathetic, and professional manner. Direct patients appropriately to clinicians, services, or allied healthcare professionals using practice care navigation guidelines. Respond promptly and efficiently to incoming telephone enquiries, routine requests, and emergencies following practice protocols. Handle patient enquiries regarding test results, repeat prescriptions, and general service pathways with tact and sensitivity. 2. Clinical Systems & Administration (EMIS Web) Use the EMIS Web clinical system to schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments for GPs, nurses, and allied health staff. Process repeat prescription requests accurately and liaise with local community pharmacies as necessary. Register new patients, verify ID documents, and process temporary patient registrations in compliance with NHS guidelines. Monitor online triage requests, digital consultations, and practice messaging channels. 3. Document Management & Workflow Scan, code, and attach incoming clinical correspondence, hospital discharge summaries, and pathology lab results to patient electronic records. Action tasks and messages assigned by GPs, nurses, and administrative management in a timely manner. Maintain strict adherence to NHS Information Governance, GDPR, and patient confidentiality policies at all times. 4. Health, Safety & Practice Operations Maintain a clean, tidy, and welcoming reception and waiting room environment. Assist in opening and securing the practice building in line with daily security procedures. Follow infection prevention and control guidelines, safeguarding procedures (for children and vulnerable adults), and practice health and safety standards. Participate in practice team meetings, annual appraisals, and mandatory NHS training modules.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Medical Receptionist - Hendon NW4 Receptionist wanted to work for a busy, friendly, doctors surgery in Sunningfields Road NW4. Priority will be given to those with reception experience within a GP practice/healthcare organisation. Those who can prove they have transferrable skills are also welcome to apply. Hours of work would be: - Monday 08:00 to 13:00 - 5 hours Tuesday 08:00 to 13:00 - 5 hours Wednesday 08:00 to 13:00 - 5 hours Thursday 08:00 to 13:00 - 5 hours Friday 08:00 to 13:00 - 5 hours Total of 25 hours, and you may be asked to do additional hours to cover absence. Pay is £12.91 per hour rising to £14.80 per hour after full training. The successful candidate will need to start as soon as possible. When applying please state your notice period that you have with your current employer. Closing Date: Monday 12/10/26. N.B. we may close the advert early if we have a suitable number of applicants apply. Note for students: Please ensure you are free to do the hours and days specified above before you apply. We need a person who can work every day stated, during the hours stated. We will not adapt to fit around your study timetable. Previous applicants need not apply. No agencies. To answer general enquiries. To process repeat prescription requests. Respond to all queries and requests for assistance from patients and other visitors Book interpreters when needed Ensure reception and waiting areas are neat and tidy Ensure total familiarity with all appointment systems in effect Book appointments and recalls Answer external and internal telephones promptly Receive and make calls as required. Divert calls and take messages as appropriate. Ensure that the system is operational at the beginning of the day To receive and accurately record messages for GPs, nurses and any other staff To deal with patient requests for test results Management of medical records Documentation management To act as chaperone on occasions for the doctors or nurses. To attend training when organised by the Practice Manager To attend meetings when necessary Any other duties appropriate to the grade MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Reception Duties Utilise computer system to ensure efficiency of appointment system and monitor flow of patients into consulting and treatment rooms To make new or follow-up appointments over the telephone or in person in accordance with the Practice Policy Ensure that patients who need urgent appointments are seen in accordance with the Practice Policy To answer general enquiries in person or on the telephone, explaining surgery procedures. Explain practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover, ensuring procedures are completed. To receive written repeat prescription requests and to issue repeat prescriptions and set out for doctors to check and sign before collection. Advise patients of relevant charges for private services, accept payment and issue receipts for same. Action requests for ambulance transportation Take appropriate action for booking interpreters Relay messages in accordance with Practice Policy Receive samples over the desk and store in accordance with Practice Policy until collection Ensure reception and waiting areas are kept neat and tidy and stocked with relevant patient information MANAGEMENT OF APPOINTMENT SYSTEM Monitor effectiveness of the system and report any problems to your manager OPERATION OF TELEPHONE SYSTEM Retrieve and re file records as required, ensuring strict alphabetical order is adhered to. Ensure correspondence, reports, results etc are filed in correct order Ensure new records are merged with old notes in line with practice policy Ensure records are kept neat and tidy and in good repair with necessary information recorded correctly on the cover. To complete necessary documentation for all patients, registered and non-registered making sure all registration forms, new medical records, immunisation cards, summary cards, change of address and temporary registration forms are all complete before the patient see the doctor or nurse SCANNING To scan all documents in accordance with the Practice PolicyTo file all scanned documents in the appropriate filing system START AND END OF PROCEDURES Open up the premises at the start of the day, and make all necessary preparation to receive patients. GENERAL To operate the practice computer, maintaining accurate patient registration details, printing prescriptions making appointments etc. To attend meetings with the Reception Manager and/or Practice Manager when necessary To assist with mailings and patient recall letters Photocopy, fax and distribute literature Shredding confidential material Opening and distributing post The post holder may be required to change his/her principal responsibilities at any time should the needs of the organisation so demand.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: A medical receptionist is the primary representative of our GP Practice. A medical receptionist will need to be capable of handling stressful situations at any given time in order to serve the patients. We require someone with experience who can join our team and bring with them the above skills that will enhance the care we provide to our patients. Our patients are our forefront and we them to have a positive experience when they access health care provided by the surgery. We are looking for a full-time or part-time team member to meet the needs of our practice. Our shift patterns are usually as follows for full-time 2 days, 7:30-15:30, 2 days 11:00-19:00 and 1 day 9:00- 17:00 this can be discussed if successful at the interview. If this is you do not hesitate and apply and come and join our work family. This is a small practice with a small friendly team which supports each other to provide the best health care The following are the core responsibilities of the Receptionist. There may be, on occasion, a requirement to carry out other tasks. This will be dependent upon factors such as workload and staffing levels: a. Maintain and monitor the practice appointment system b. Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments c. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately d. Signpost patients to the correct service e. Initiating contact with and responding to, requests from patients, team members and external agencies f. Code data on the clinical IT system g. Photocopy documentation as required h. Data entry of new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information as required i. Input data into patients healthcare records as necessary j. Direct requests for information, i.e., SAR, insurance/solicitors letters and DVLA forms to the administrative team k. Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner l. Carry out system searches as requested m. Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times n. Monitor and maintain the reception area and notice boards o. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested To be responsible for undertaking a wide range of reception duties and the provision of general support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties can include, but are not limited to, greeting and directing patients, effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, the processing of information and assisting patients as required. To act as the central point of contact for patients, be responsible for the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaise with multi-disciplinary team members and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Chelsfield Surgery is looking for two friendly, organised and patient-focused Medical Receptionist to join our busy and supportive GP practice team. As the first point of contact for patients, you will play a key role in delivering excellent customer service, managing appointments, handling telephone and face-to-face enquiries, processing administrative tasks and supporting the wider multidisciplinary team. We are seeking someone with excellent communication skills, strong IT abilities and a professional, caring approach. Previous receptionist or administrative experience is essential, and experience within a GP practice or healthcare setting would be advantageous. Training will be provided for the right candidate. This is a permanent part-time position of 16-17 hours per week, with flexibility required to cover annual leave and occasional additional shifts when needed. Welcoming and assisting patients at reception Managing appointments and patient enquiries Answering and directing telephone calls Processing registrations and maintaining patient records Managing incoming and outgoing correspondence Signposting patients to appropriate services Supporting clinicians and the wider practice team with administrative tasks Maintaining confidentiality and data security at all times Medical Receptionist (16-17 hours per week) Chelsfield Surgery is seeking a friendly, organised and professional Medical Receptionist to join our busy practice team. As the first point of contact for patients, you will provide a welcoming and efficient reception service both face-to-face and over the telephone. You will be responsible for managing appointments, handling patient enquiries, processing registrations, maintaining patient records and supporting the wider clinical and administrative teams. Greet and assist patients at reception. Answer and manage telephone enquiries professionally. Book, amend and cancel patient appointments. Signpost patients to the most appropriate service. Process patient registrations and update patient records. Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence. Process referrals and administrative requests in line with practice procedures. Support clinicians and colleagues with general administrative tasks. Maintain confidentiality, data security and information governance standards. Contribute to a positive patient experience and effective team working. We are looking for someone who: Has excellent communication and customer service skills. Is confident using IT systems, Microsoft Office and Outlook. Can work effectively under pressure in a busy environment. Has strong organisational and time management skills. Enjoys working as part of a team. Is flexible, reliable and professional. Previous receptionist, administrative or customer service experience is essential. Experience within a GP practice, NHS or healthcare setting and knowledge of EMIS would be advantageous.

title: GP Receptionist - Bow
description: Are you an experienced GP Receptionist looking to join a friendly, supportive and patient-focused practice? St Stephen's Health Centre is seeking a motivated and professional Receptionist to become part of our busy front-line team. As one of the first points of contact for patients, you will play a vital role in creating a positive patient experience and ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. We are looking for someone with at least one year's experience working in a healthcare setting who enjoys helping others, communicates confidently and remains calm in a fast-paced environment. In retur You will be responsible for providing a professional reception service, acting as a key point of contact for patients, visitors and external organisations. Duties include managing appointments, answering telephone enquiries, processing registrations, handling correspondence, maintaining accurate patient records and supporting clinicians with administrative tasks. The successful candidate will work closely with the wider practice team to ensure patients receive an efficient, friendly and high-quality service whilst maintaining confidentiality and accuracy at all times Provide a professional and welcoming reception service to patients and visitors. Answer and manage telephone enquiries appropriately. Maintain and update patient records accurately. Process patient registrations and appointment bookings. Manage incoming correspondence, emails and documents. Scan and file documentation within agreed timescales. Process prescription requests and administrative tasks. Support recall and disease register programmes. Ensure patient confidentiality is maintained at all times. Work closely with clinicians and colleagues to support the smooth running of the practice.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are looking to recruit an exceptional Medical Receptionist to complement our existing team. The hours are part-time (25 hrs) across 5 days: Mondays: 8am - 4pm Tuesdays: 4pm - 8pm Wednesdays: Day Off Thursdays: 8am - 12 noon Fridays: 8am - 4pm Alternate Saturdays: 8am - 12 noon This role would suit someone who is looking for an opportunity to develop their existing customer service skills in a fast-paced progressive environment. The ideal candidate will have excellent verbal and written communication skills. They will be empathetic, compassionate, patient focused and driven to provide exacting standards of care. We require someone who is resilient, adaptable to change, positive, enthusiastic, and an effective team player. Experience in EMIS Web and Docman is desirable but not essential. The purpose of this role is to deliver a high level of customer care to patients. The receptionists are front-line and should promote a professional and friendly image to patients and visitors at all times. They also provide an essential support function to the clinical and management teams. Duties and responsibilities Dealing with enquiries from patients, internal personnel and external organisations in a professional and efficient manner. Receiving and directing patients and visitors on arrival at the practice with courtesy. Dealing with Anima requests in a friendly professional manner, ensuring confidentiality according to the practice procedure. Handling all telephone enquiries and requests within the practice telephone protocol. Operating the clinical system to book, cancel and amend appointments. Operating the clinical system to input and retrieve data as required. Responsible for receiving and recording messages efficiently and accurately according to practice procedure, ensuring that messages are conveyed to the clinical team in a timely manner. Liaising with the doctors regarding requests for home visits. Booking home visits as per practice protocol. Arranging interpreting services as and when required. Ensuring that all patient registration procedures are carried out accurately and that patients complete the necessary documentation. Ensuring that patient records are up to date and that information recorded is accurate and relevant. Dealing with patient tasks and requests on Anima and Emis tasks according to practice procedure. Managing outgoing mail as appropriate. Photocopying information when necessary. Responsible for handover at change of shift those outstanding queries and messages. Assisting with the resolution of patient complaints informally wherever possible. Escalating complaints to the Reception Managers or Complaints Manager as appropriate. Ensuring that the practice complaints leaflet is available to patients upon request. Ensuring the reception and waiting areas are kept clean, safe and tidy at all times. Responsibility for opening up and closing down the building as per practice procedure. Ensure till takings are accurately documented according to practice procedure. Attending any necessary training/ courses. Understanding and participating in annual appraisal and review. To be aware of the practice Health and Safety policies and ensure that correct and safe procedures are followed. To observe the rule of patient confidentiality and be aware of the Data Protection Act. The Practice may close this recruitment process earlier than advertised.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Fernlea Surgery, is a busy and well-establish GP Practice in South Tottenham, North London, is seeking an enthusiastic Medical Receptionist/Administrator to join our friendly and supportive Medical Administration team. We have an excellent team of GPs and Nurses, a supportive Management Team and efficient administrative team. Our Practice list size is approximately 12,500. We are open to full time and part time applicants and can offer a range of shifts between Monday to Friday. Shifts would range from 8am - 6:30pm with either a 8am start or 1pm. What we offer A competitive salary Paid 30 minute lunch break per day NHS Pension scheme Paid DBS Starting with 20 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) Free on-site car parking Supportive and welcoming team environment Full training and development opportunities Main duties of the job This is a varied, rewarding position in a busy GP practice setting. The Medical Receptionist/Administrator will work across both administrative and reception functions within the practice, providing reliable operational support to clinicians and the wider multidisciplinary team. The role requires an individual who can work confidently with clinical systems, manage competing priorities, and provide a professional patient-facing service while exercising judgement and initiative. Job responsibilities Main duties and responsibilities of the post 1. Administrative and coordination responsibilities Undertake a broad range of administrative duties to support the effective running of the practice Process patient information (electronic and hard copy) accurately, securely, and in a timely manner Monitor, manage, and action incoming emails, electronic tasks, and workflow requests independently Carry out searches, audits, recalls, and administrative reporting as required Type letters, reports, referrals, and associated clinical documentation Respond to administrative requests from clinicians, using judgement to prioritise actions Identify system issues, workflow gaps, or risks and escalate appropriately Report faults to software suppliers and/or IT support and track progress 2. Reception and patient-facing responsibilities Act as a professional and confident point of contact for patients, both face to face and via telephone Respond to patient enquiries using judgement to prioritise urgent, complex, or sensitive matters Support safe navigation of patients to the most appropriate service in line with practice policy Book appointments, recalls, and follow-ups accurately using the computerised appointment system Monitor patient flow and waiting times and escalate concerns appropriately Explain practice procedures, registration processes, and temporary resident arrangements clearly 3. Clinical systems and medical records Assist with the accurate input, updating, and maintenance of patient records on EMIS Clinically code data and correspondence where appropriate Scan, upload, and file patient-related documentation promptly Open, date-stamp, and distribute correspondence, reports, and results to relevant clinicians Arrange retrieval, transfer, and re-filing of medical records as required 4. Communication and telephone systems Receive and make telephone calls in accordance with practice policy, using clear communication and active listening Take accurate messages and ensure timely communication with clinicians and team members Ensure the telephone system is operational at the start of each day and switched to night service at the end of the day 5. Start and end of day procedures Open the premises at the start of the day, deactivate alarms, and prepare the practice to receive patients Secure the premises at the end of the day, ensuring the building is locked and alarms activated Be able to work shifts between 8.00am and 6.30pm as required 6. Professional responsibilities Maintain strict confidentiality at all times Demonstrate the ability to think independently, problem-solve, and manage competing priorities Use initiative, discretion, and common sense when responding to patient and operational issues Communicate effectively with colleagues, clinicians, and external organisations Maintain a clean, organised, and efficient working environment Communicate and work collaboratively with colleagues at all levels, treating others with professionalism, courtesy, and respect at all times. 7. Additional duties Undertake any other delegated duties appropriate to the role This job description outlines the main duties of the post and may be reviewed and amended in line with service needs.

title: Patient Services Advisor/receptionist
description: Are you an experienced Receptionist/Administrative assistant or someone with transferrable skills who is good with people and can balance a varying workload? The Reception teams across Groves Health are the lynchpin of our business and support the Group to provide a first class service to our patients and the wider community. The role:- This is a varied role which will give you the opportunity to have exposure to different parts of Reception/Administration on a rotating basis within a busy GP surgery. Some of your duties will include:- Booking telephone appointments with patients Managing the incoming email inbox and patient requests Responding to patient queries via the Practice website dashboard Greeting patients when they arrive in the Practice and dealing with queries Calling patients on behalf of GP's to book appointments and relay information Managing incoming mail and distributing/scanning accordingly On occasion opening and closing the Practice Working with outside agencies such as Pharmacies and Care homes for patient care Registering new patients Using Practice software such as EMIS, Docman (training provided) and Office products Groves Health is a successful and trusted provider of NHS services across England. Over the past five years, we have grown from a single practice in New Malden to a team of more than 100 people, providing high-quality care to patients and communities across our four sites in New Malden, Richmond, Wimbledon and Hinchley Wood. As Groves Health continues to grow and expand the services we provide, we are looking for an enthusiastic and reliable Receptionist & Administrator to join our team at Groves Vineyard Surgery in Wimbledon . We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, is well organised and can manage a varied workload in a busy environment. Previous experience in a GP practice, healthcare or administrative setting would be beneficial, but we are also keen to hear from candidates with transferable skills and a strong commitment to providing excellent customer service. Our Reception teams play a vital role in the day-to-day running of our practices. As one of the first points of contact for patients, you will help ensure that patients receive a friendly, professional and efficient service. This is a varied role, providing the opportunity to develop your knowledge and experience across different areas of reception and administration within a busy GP surgery. Your duties will include, but are not limited to: Booking and managing telephone appointments for patients. Managing the practice email inbox and responding to patient requests. Responding to patient queries through the practice website and online services. Welcoming patients to the practice and dealing with their queries in a professional and helpful manner. Contacting patients on behalf of GPs and other members of the clinical team to arrange appointments or relay information. Receiving, sorting, scanning and distributing incoming post and correspondence. Registering new patients and ensuring their information is accurately recorded. Liaising with external organisations, including pharmacies, care homes and other healthcare services, where appropriate to support patient care. Using practice and administrative systems, including EMIS, Docman and Microsoft Office . Full training will be provided where required. Supporting colleagues with general administrative duties and contributing to the smooth running of the practice. Assisting with the opening and closing of the practice when required. We are looking for someone who: Has excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Is friendly, approachable and professional. Has a strong commitment to providing excellent patient service. Is organised and able to prioritise competing demands. Can remain calm and professional when working in a busy environment. Has good attention to detail and is confident using computer systems. Is able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Is adaptable and willing to learn new systems and processes. Understands the importance of confidentiality and handling patient information appropriately. Previous experience within a GP practice, NHS or healthcare environment would be advantageous, but is not essential. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation where you will be part of a supportive team and have the opportunity to develop your skills and experience within primary care. If you are enthusiastic, organised and passionate about providing a high-quality service to patients, we would love to hear from you.

title: Medical Administrator
description: HAMPSTEAD GROUP PRACTICE (NW3 2QU) Medical Administrator Part-Time Post (25 - 30 hours per week) Hourly rate: £14.80 - £15.50 Working days: Monday - Friday We are seeking a motivated and reliable Administrator to join our busy and friendly team. The successful candidate will provide efficient administrative and secretarial support to the partners and clinical staff, ensuring high standards of service and patient care are maintained. The role involves managing clinical correspondence, processing referrals via the NHS e-Referral Service, and general administrative tasks. You will also process insurance forms, medical reports and medical record requests within agreed timescales, ensuring accurate record keeping and maintaining strict patient confidentiality. The ideal candidate will have excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team managing a varied workload in a fast-paced environment. Previous NHS or primary care experience and knowledge of EMIS are desirable but not essential. This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive team within a well-established practice for a fixed-term maternity cover position. Provide administrative and secretarial support to GPs and clinical staff Preparation of medical correspondence Process patient referrals using the NHS e-Referral Service Manage insurance forms, medical reports and associated payments Process requests for copies of patient medical records Maintain accurate records and ensure documents are scanned into patient files Support cervical screening programme, QOF and flu campaigns Respond to patient and clinician queries relating to referrals and medical administration Provide occasional reception cover when required Manage workflow and coding Manage and action emails. Assist with Lab results. HAMPSTEAD GROUP PRACTICE Title: Medical Administrator Accountable to: Practice Manager Reports to: Practice Manager Liases with: Patients and Users of the Practice Professional Members of the Practice Team Patient Services Team and administrative staff PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVES OF THE ROLE To provide efficient and effective administrative and secretarial support to the partners and medical staff of the practice. The role involves coordinating a range of administrative processes and ensuring services are delivered within agreed quality standards and timeframes. KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Secretarial and Administrative Support Provide efficient and effective secretarial support to partners and medical staff to an agreed quality standard and within agreed timeframes. Type all relevant practice correspondence as required, including Fit Notes requiring GP electronic signatures. Type medical reports as required. Record minutes of meetings when required. Provide administrative support such as photocopying, scanning and postal duties. Clinical Correspondence and Referrals Act as a first point of contact for doctors and patients with queries relating to medical matters and referrals. Process patient referrals promptly using the NHS e-Referral Service (eRS). Check the e-Referral Service system daily for rejected referrals and outstanding referral letters. Follow up queries relating to previously typed or submitted referrals. Deal with Advice and Guidance queries and responses. Maintain systems to ensure prompt processing of referrals and correspondence. Be responsible for two-week wait (urgent cancer referral) safety-net checks, ideally conducted weekly. Provide training to staff on the NHS e-Referral Service process when required. Medical Certification and Clinical Administration Send electronic copies of death certificates to Camden Registrars including patient next of kin details. Send cremation forms electronically to funeral directors and ensure copies are scanned into patient records. Process Telederm referrals including taking photographs of skin lesions and uploading them to EMIS records. Provide training to GPs on Telederm processes when required. Insurance Forms, Medical Reports and Claims Ensure that insurance forms, statutory claims forms and medical report requests are processed within 15 working days. Responsibilities include: Maintaining the insurance/claims and medical reports database. Logging all requests daily with the date received. Forwarding forms to the appropriate GP or partner for completion. Monitoring outstanding requests and following up incomplete forms. Ensuring completed documents are scanned and stored in the patients record. Dispatching completed documentation promptly to patients or requesting organisations. Processing income generated from these services and chasing outstanding payments. Distributing income received to salaried doctors where appropriate. Collating partner income and submitting records to the Business Manager and Finance Administrator for payroll processing. Subject Access Requests (Medical Records) Ensure requests for copies of medical records are processed within 28 working days. Logging all requests with the date of receipt. Preparing copies of paper and electronic records. Completing the initial check for third-party information. Passing records to a GP to check for third-party information. Ensuring redacted pages are scanned and appropriately coded in the patient record. Arranging secure transfer of records via recorded delivery, collection or encrypted email. Cervical Screening Administration Provide administrative support for the Cervical Screening Programme in accordance with national protocols. Inputting smear screening data into patient records. Monitoring and chasing outstanding smear results. Sending recall letters to non-responders. Processing Prior Notification Lists via Open Exeter within deadlines. Managing the colposcopy failsafe system. Supporting quarterly cervical screening targets as part of QoF and Enhanced Services. Medical Records Management Process urgent medical record requests and complete the appropriate request forms. Email urgent requests to PCSE and file copies within patient records. Follow up with PCSE if records are delayed. Ensure newly received records are reviewed by a GP and passed for summarisation if required. Document Management Undertake daily scanning of completed medical reports, insurance forms and related correspondence. Ensure scanning is completed in line with the Docman protocol. Additional Duties Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with information governance requirements. Maintain up-to-date contact records for affiliated organisations and services. Provide support to the management team when required. Assist with reception cover during staff shortages. Support practice activities such as the annual Flu Campaign and QOF targets. Undertake relevant training courses with agreement from the Practice Manager. Prepare refreshments for doctors coffee according to the rota. The Practice Manager will allocate duties, or the Business Manager in their absence. Duties may change to meet the operational needs of the practice. This job description is not exhaustive and may be amended by agreement between the Practice Manager and the post holder.
